title_zh: 核对档案室通行证续期要求

scenario.label_zh: 核对档案室通行证续期要求
scenario.goal_zh: 确认通行证用途、到期日及证件要求，并约定携证回来办理

context_zh: 访客在地方档案室服务台询问通行证；本场景的证件要求由工作人员明确给出。
author: author-phase11-a

sentences.speaker: Ruth
sentences.text: Does this pass also let me into the museum next door?

sentences.speaker: Amir
sentences.text: No, it is exclusively for the archive reading room.

sentences.speaker: Ruth
sentences.text: I see that it will expire on Friday. Can I renew it today?

sentences.speaker: Amir
sentences.text: Yes, if you have photo identification. We need to check the name against your record.

sentences.speaker: Ruth
sentences.text: Mine is at home. I'll bring it tomorrow, then.

sentences.speaker: Amir
sentences.text: That works. We'll check it at this desk and deal with the renewal then.
